# Reptilians
## General information
They can use their tail to drag objects around, keeping both their hands free.
Their sharp claws make their unarmed attacks deal Slash damage, rather than Blunt.
Their specialized digestive systems can only process fruits and meat, but they can also digest raw meat and blood without any ill effects. They are also poisoned by chemicals such as allicin (found in garlic and onions) and theobromine (found in caffinated beverages and chocolate).
They take [color=#ffa500]30% more Cold damage.[/color] They prefer a somewhat warmer temperature range than humans.
